title: Editor’s Note: ‘Volatility’ Describes Market Reforms, Demand, Transmission in 2026

meta.summary:
Market reform in PJM and the Western markets can be described with one word: volatility. Meanwhile, public opposition to data centers is growing across North America, with at least 500 local governments in the U.S. approving moratoria or bans on data centers.
